summary: This directory serves as the root orchestration layer for the form generation library, aggregating domain-specific language structures, core engine logic, and error handling systems into a cohesive, exportable package.
responsibilities: Provide a unified entry point for library consumers
Expose core form generation and validation capabilities
Aggregate domain-specific language definitions for form metadata
relationships: The entry point exports the form engine and DSL components to allow library users to initialize and configure form generation.
The error management system provides support services that the engine utilizes to handle validation and processing faults during form operations.
designDecisions: Barrel file export strategy to provide a clean and simplified API surface
Centralized package structure to manage internal dependencies between core, dsl, and error modules
Modular encapsulation to separate functional concerns from public exports
